title: finsights.explore stock universe (config/stocks.json)
description: Edited by hand. The data job reads tickers and industries only from this file.

industries.description: id -> labels. The id is what each stock points at in 'industry'.

tr.description: Turkish label shown in the app

cyclical.description: Commodity or economic-cycle driven; the screener warns about it

k.description: Ticker as shown in the app, unique within its market

bank.description: Bank: evaluated with its own method; NPL, CAR and NIM come from banks_manual.json

cyc.description: Overrides the industry's cyclical flag for this stock

tv.description: TradingView symbol EXCHANGE:TICKER. Optional for BIST (default BIST:<k>), required for US (the exchange cannot be guessed)

yf.description: Yahoo Finance symbol. Defaults: <k>.IS for BIST, <k> for US

usd.description: Functional-currency note for BIST companies that keep their books in another currency, e.g. USD or EUR

note.description: Hand-written comment shown in the stock detail

noteAsOf.description: ISO day the note was written
